name: Blood Twilight

Pledge: Castle Thorn: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Castle Thorn.
summary: This article is about the boss in Castle Thorn. For the generic enemy, see Blood Twilight (Solstice). The Blood Twilight is a grievous twilight summoned by Talfyg after he steals some of Gwendis's essence. It appears in the Garden Conservatory of Castle Thorn, and serves as the second boss of the dungeon.
